clarification: No directed trust path from 0 to 5000 exists; see variants for reverse/undirected interpretations.
The graph is undirected (per the dataset description), so in-degree is not distinct from degree; reported the undirected degree of node 0.
Graph is disconnected, so its diameter is infinite in the strict sense; reporting the diameter of the largest connected component.

The edge weights count shared chapters, so a higher weight means a closer tie, not a longer distance. Treating them as path lengths would misrepresent the network, so this value uses hop counts. The betweenness tool does not report its settings; I inferred hop-count paths and an unnormalized scale from the values it returned, not from tool settings. If you need the normalized value (0–1 scale), I can compute it.
